messages:
matt: Quick sync — need alignment on Q2 private-onramp launch gates. Two pilot customers (Acme + Lumen). Core asks: dedicated capacity commit, KMS/HSM integration, staging windows. Can we capture owners and cut decisions here?
rene: wfm. main tech risk is runtime memory at 32k context with quantized model. Sam can you confirm perf envelope for the q4 quant?
sam: looked at canary logs from yesterday. quant q4 is ~1.8x slower on long context but still hits ~250ms/token p50 for single-stream small batches. main ask: prewarm pool of 6 GPUs for stable throughput in pilot.
jia: infra: we can reserve 6 GPUs in a dedicated pool but need ~48h lead time for tenant networking + cert provisioning and subnet peering with customer VPC. also need route tables updated.
olivia: security checklist: KMS policy review + HSM provisioning, pen test signoff for the private image, and updated SOC docs. estimate ~10 business days for full signoff. we can fast-track KMS if we reuse an existing HSM tenant but that has compliance tradeoffs.
matt: product constraint — customers expect pilot in 3 weeks. if sec is 10 business days and infra is 48h, we may need to scope cut to hit that date.
tyler: eng-sre: we can temporarily relax p50 latency SLO for pilot traffic (explicit non-SLA pilot mode). that avoids an immediate runtime refactor.
amanda: solutions engineering checked — customers are fine with a "pilot: best-effort perf" if data residency (VPC) + log retention (30d) are guaranteed and there's a signed pilot agreement.
rene: propose splitting gates: (A) networking & certs (owner: jia) due +5 days, (B) KMS/HSM signoff (owner: olivia) due +12 days, (C) capacity bake/prewarm (owners: sam + tyler) due +7 days, (D) QA eval + pilot agreement (owners: matt + amanda) due +10 days. fallback plan: if KMS misses, offer hosted variant with Redwood-managed KMS for pilot only.
sam: can commit to capacity bake by +7 days if infra starts today. will need 3 engineers allocated: sam, a runtime lead, and tyler for SRE.
jia: starting network work today. created infra ticket INF-4219 and added checklist: subnet peer, cert, route rules. will post progress.
olivia: kicked off KMS review SEC-889. please attach data flow diagram + minimal threat model. will share draft by EOD tomorrow.
matt: i'll drop a short scope-cut doc in the product docs folder and tag legal. agree on fallback.
deploy-bot: INFO: release window reserved 2024-07-10 04:00 UTC for pilot deploy (slot reserved)
matt: action items summary (timestamps are epoch due approximations): jia = network & certs (due 1733560000), olivia = KMS signoff (due 1733610000), sam + tyler = capacity bake (due 1733570000), matt + amanda = QA eval & pilot agreement (due 1733580000). I'll follow up with calendar invites.
rene: thanks all — let's reconvene in 48h. :thumbsup:
